title: Forza Horizon 6
provenance: verified locally on Apple Silicon (M4, 32 GB), macOS 27.0, Wine 11 engine r18 release candidate with D3DMetal 4.0b2, 2026-10-05. Arachne1111 (highball-db#390, 2026-10-08): rated 3, playable with workarounds, after 25 minutes, Apple M5 Max, macOS 27.0.1, Highball 0.10.12, engine x64-crossover26.3-r18, D3DMetal, Windows 11, 192 dpi, AVX advertised, the forza-horizon-6 recipe applied. Okami0ne (highball-db#438, 2026-10-10): rated 4 of 5 after 22 minutes, Apple M2 Pro, macOS 27.0.1, Highball 0.10.10, engine x64-crossover26.3-r18, D3DMetal, with frame drops and micro freezes. Beepdax (highball-db#449, 2026-10-11): rated 4 of 5 after 61 minutes, Apple M5 Pro, macOS 27.0.1, Highball 0.10.10, engine x64-crossover26.3-r18, the forza-horizon-6 recipe, about 47 fps at 1440p on Medium without frame generation.
notes: Plays from the intro through races and free roam on the Wine 11 engine r18 (D3DMetal 4), macOS 27 only. Base M4 at 1080p: 28 fps on High, 38 on Medium with FSR Balanced, 50 on Very Low; 39 to 48 in a race at Medium. The recipe sets the engine and the graphics card D3DMetal reports (the AMD default crashes the game). Xbox sign-in once, by code at microsoft.com/link. Built-in Benchmark Mode shows a black screen. Liveries, factory paint reflections and trees draw right from engine r28 (Highball 0.10.23), which works around a D3DMetal vertex layout bug; the same release lets the game offer DLSS Super Resolution (on MetalFX) with Enable DLSS (MetalFX) on, since the recipe now has D3DMetal report an NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4070. Online play and controllers not tested. A player on an M5 Max played 25 minutes on 0.10.12 and rated it playable with workarounds, without naming them. A player on an M2 Pro played 22 minutes on 0.10.10 and rated it playable, with frame drops and the micro freezes the copy protection causes. Voices and most of the engine sound were missing on every Mac until Highball 0.10.16 (beta), whose Wine 11 engine r24 plays the game's whole surround mix through Apple's spatial mixer. Pick r24 under Advanced, Engine in the game's environment.

d3dmetal.detail: D3DMetal 4.0b2 only. D3DMetal 3.0 is refused by the game (FH205, no enhanced barriers).

dxmt.detail: DirectX 12 only, DXMT has no DirectX 12

verified.fps: 28 at High native, 33 at High + FSR Balanced, 38 at Medium + FSR Balanced, 44 at Low + FSR Balanced, 50 at Very Low + FSR Balanced, all at 1920x1080 in Tokyo City with the Metal HUD, D3DMetal 4.0b2, base M4

knownIssues.symptom: A hitch of about a tenth of a second roughly once a second, in menus, the garage and while driving
knownIssues.cause: the game's copy protection runs a periodic check of about 2,000 deliberate traps while holding a lock the frame needs. Under Rosetta each trap costs about 50 microseconds against 1 to 2 on a PC, so a check of a few milliseconds takes about 100 (measured on an M4)
knownIssues.fix: none in Highball. No setting removes it: priorities, Game Mode and fewer processors were measured and shorten it by a fifth at best. It would take cheaper traps in Rosetta or a change in the game

knownIssues.symptom: Liveries look washed out or missing (the car shows mostly its base paint), factory paint has blotchy, faceted reflections, and trees sway oddly (an M5 in highball#290, an M5 Pro in highball-db#449, an M4 Max)
knownIssues.cause: D3DMetal 4.0 beta 2 and beta 3 place vertex attributes that the game's input layouts give as D3D12_APPEND_ALIGNED_ELEMENT at the wrong offsets, so its shaders read other attributes' bytes: the livery vinyls' coverage came from texcoord data, normals and tangents were shifted, and so was the trees' wind data. Found and measured on an M4 Max, macOS 27.0.1, 2026-10-20
knownIssues.fix: engine r28 (Highball 0.10.23): its D3DMetal shim writes those offsets out. Accept the engine Play offers, or pick r28 under Advanced, Engine

knownIssues.symptom: Snow and patches of ground can turn black (an M5 Pro in highball-db#449)
knownIssues.cause: not investigated. D3DMetal 4.0 beta 3 cannot build the game's screen-space shadow mask pipelines (their pixel shaders read SV_ShadingRate, which Metal's shader converter turns into an input the vertex shader never writes) and draws nothing with them, which may be related

knownIssues.symptom: Dialogue, the navigator's voice and most of the engine sound are missing, on any Mac with a two-channel output such as its speakers or headphones (an M5 Max, an M5 Pro, an M5, an M2 Pro)
knownIssues.cause: the game mixes through Windows spatial audio as a 7.1.4 bed of twelve channels, Wine cannot set that layout on a two-channel output, and only the front left and right channels are heard. Found by @TxCsOffc (highball#313)
knownIssues.fix: Highball 0.10.16 (beta), engine x64-crossover26.3-r24: Tx's patches (highball#313) render the 12-channel bed with Apple's AUSpatialMixer for the Mac's speakers or headphones, so every channel is heard. Measured on an M4: the game's 12-channel bed and an 8-channel stream go through the mixer, and a 7.1.4 test bed reaches the speakers on every channel. Existing environments keep their engine, so pick r24 under Advanced, Engine. New environments made from the game's recipe get it by themselves.
